item.text: I’m starting with “New year, new pots,” which explains the app, offer and eligibility before people click. The campaign targets UK adults, with a $450 total cap and $41 daily pacing, through the end of January 12 UK time. I’ll check delivery and spend throughout the run.

The first day delivered 19 link clicks and 30,854 impressions for $40.26. Delivery is on budget. I’m keeping the offer-led post running while the small click sample builds; these results don’t tell us how many people installed.

Through January 4, spend is $114.00 for 68 link clicks. Average cost per click has improved to $1.68. I’ve raised daily pacing slightly to $43 to account for earlier underspend, keeping the $450 total cap.

The campaign has spent $196.35 and delivered 102 link clicks through January 6. Click costs have risen over the last two days. I’m retaining the post that clearly explains the app and download offer, since we have no install data to validate whether the more conversational post would attract better prospects.
Through January 8, totals are $273.17 spent, 225,491 impressions and 131 link clicks. I’ve adjusted daily pacing to $45 for the remaining four days, within the original total cap.

item.text: With two days remaining, spend is $349.70 for 174 link clicks. Recent click costs have improved. Daily pacing is now $52 to give the remaining $100.30 room to deliver before the scheduled finish.
At midday on the final day, reported spend is $407.35 with 204 link clicks. The campaign remains capped at $450 and is scheduled to stop at midnight UK time.

The January 2–12 UK campaign has ended and is paused. I monitored delivery daily using the approved “New year, new pots” post.

- Spend: **$448.48 USD** of $450
- Impressions: **420,877**
- Link clicks: **221**

Actual installs weren’t measurable through X.
